headline: Mexico Attracts Record $43.1 Billion FDI as New Investments Fall 42%
summary: Mexico attracted a record $43.09 billion in foreign direct investment through September, though new investment fell 42% and accounted for just 8.8% of the total.
why: Mexico is a primary nearshoring destination for North American manufacturing, and FDI composition reflects capital expenditure momentum versus corporate reinvestments.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Overall FDI reached record highs, but a sharp drop in brand-new investments points to slowing new enterprise commitments.
